description: Declarative configuration for the procedural design engine. Values mirror the current Dart defaults (printability.dart consts, kDefault*Scorers weights, DesignEngineBudget) so this file documents the source of truth without yet driving it. When wired, the runtime should load these instead of hard-coded constants.

printability._comment: Hard gate — a design failing any of these is never scored/rendered. Mirrors printability.dart (verified 2026-08).

budget._comment: OptimizationLoop budget. Tuned for real-time on-device generation (see architecture §Risks).

scoreWeights._comment: Aggregate DesignScore.total() weights (verified: wAesthetic 0.7, wFit 0.3). printabilityMargin is a gate-margin field, not part of the default total.

aiCritic._comment: Tier 3 — optional cloud vision re-rank. Remote-flag gated, non-blocking, never on the print path. Off by default; the engine is fully functional without it.

determinism._comment: Named RNG sub-streams derived from DesignRecipe.seed so unrelated choices don't alias.
